title: fix(plugin-grid): import type inference requires a date shape before Date.parse (objectui#11813)
body:
Fixes #11813

Clause-②: no. An internal predicate gets stricter. No export, prop, `@object-ui/types` member or accepted input changes; `inferColumnType` keeps its signature and returns `text` where it wrongly returned `date`.

## What changed

`isDateLike` in `packages/plugin-grid/src/importParsers.ts` was `!isNumberLike(s) && !isNaN(Date.parse(s))`. V8's legacy `Date.parse` skips unknown words before the first number and reads any word whose first three letters spell a month. Measured in Node 22.22.0:

| value | `Date.parse` reads it as |
|---|---|
| `Phase 2` | 2001-02-01 |
| `Building 7` | 2001-07-01 |
| `Room 12` | 2001-12-01 |
| `Imported QA task 1` | 2001-01-01 |
| `Marketing 2026` | 2026-03-01 |
| `Room 101, Oct` | 0101-10-01 |
| `A-12` | 2001-12-01 |
| `1.2.3` | 2003-01-02 |

A value now needs an explicit date shape before `Date.parse` is asked; `Date.parse` then only confirms the parts are in range. The shapes:

- **Numeric, year first:** `2026-10-07`, `2026/10/07`, `2026.10.07`, and ISO-8601 date-times (`2026-10-07T12:00:00Z`, `2024-12-31 09:00`, `2026-10-07 12:00:00 GMT+0800`).
- **Numeric, day and month first:** a two- or four-digit year, and the same separator twice: `10/07/2026`, `7.10.2026`, `10/7/26`, optionally with a clock time (`10/07/2026 2:30 PM`).
- **ISO-8601 year-month:** `2026-10`.
- **English month-name forms:** a digit, a month name or abbreviation, and no word that is not a month, weekday, AM/PM or zone word: `Oct 7, 2026`, `7 October 2026`, `7-Oct-2026`, `Wed, 07 Oct 2026 12:00:00 GMT`. Words are read with `\p{L}` and the `u` flag, per the repo's i18n regex rule.

Only the predicate changed, inside the claim's fence (comment 6051515735). `inferColumnType`'s signature, `isNumberLike`, the mapping-hint scoring, the record conversion and `ImportWizard.tsx` are untouched. Changeset: `.changeset/11813-import-date-inference.md`, `@object-ui/plugin-grid` patch.

## Pins

In `packages/plugin-grid/src/importParsers.test.ts`, describe `inferColumnType: text ending in a number is not a date (objectui#11813)`:

- `Phase 2`, `Building 7`, `Room 12` and `Imported QA task 1` infer as `text`, singly and as a column. So do `Marketing 2026`, `Room 101, Oct`, `A-12`, `task-1` and `1.2.3`.
- Through `suggestColumnMappings`, a `Task title` column of `Imported QA task 1` and `Imported QA task 2` carries `inferredType: 'text'` and maps onto a `Title` text field. On `main` it carried `date`. The type gate then halved the soft match below the auto-apply threshold, so the column was not mapped at all.
- Control: `2026-10-07`, `2026/10/07`, `2026-10`, `10/07/2026`, `7.10.2026`, `10/7/26`, `Oct 7, 2026`, `7 October 2026`, `7-Oct-2026` and `Tuesday, October 7, 2026` infer as `date`. `2026-10-07T12:00:00Z`, `2024-03-14T08:30:00.000Z` (the ISO form the xlsx parser emits), `2026-10-07 12:00:00 GMT+0800`, `10/07/2026 2:30 PM` and `Wed, 07 Oct 2026 12:00:00 GMT` infer as `datetime`. Both hold before and after the fix.

## Reverse check

The fix was committed first (`9e7eedf`, then `d9f6c6f`). Then `importParsers.ts` was overwritten on disk with its base `cef0eee` blob: `hasDateShape` counted 0 and the old one-line `isDateLike` counted 1. The pins were run, and the file was restored with `git checkout HEAD -- PATH`. The restore was proven by blob-hash equality with `HEAD` (`cc0bbf0d`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`.

- Reverted: `Tests 11 failed | 46 passed (57)`. Every failure is `expected 'date' to be 'text'`, the predicted direction. All 16 control cases stayed green.
- Fixed: `Tests 57 passed (57)`.

## Gates

The union ran on `dfeee89`, the merge of `origin/main` at `6d8bf0c` into this branch.

| `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-grid type-check` | 0 | echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`; `--listFiles` on the test project lists `importParsers.test.ts` |
| `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2 packages/plugin-grid/` | 0 | `Test Files 188 passed (188)`, `Tests 1763 passed (1763)` |
| `pnpm check:control-bytes` | 0 | `check-control-bytes: OK` |

| `pnpm check:changeset-claims` | 0 | `No pending changeset names a file this change touches.` |
| `pnpm check:pending-changeset-literals` | 0 | `No test source names a pending changeset.` |

- **Guard tests:** the glob `*.guard.test.*` matches no file in `plugin-grid`. The three `*Guard.test.tsx` files (`importLegacyReferenceGuard`, `useRowColor.prototypeGuard`, `RowActionMenu.emptyGuard`) are among the 188 files of the package run.
- **Lint narrowing:** the population is read from the root `lint` script, `eslint . --no-inline-config`, which CI runs. The file count, 2, is read from the `--format json` output. Invariance: `eslint.config.js` sets no `parserOptions.project` or `projectService`, so linting is not type-aware, and no rule under `eslint-rules/` reads the filesystem. This diff therefore cannot move a verdict on an untouched file.
- **NOT MEASURED: `check:eager-closure`.** Reason: it reads `apps/console/dist/eager-closure.json`, which only a full console build writes; that is left to CI. `plugin-grid` is eager, because `apps/console/src/register-plugins.ts` imports it, and its chunk has no per-chunk ceiling. A standalone esbuild-minified gzip of `importParsers.ts` grows from 2,977 to 3,326 bytes (+349).

## Acceptance notes

- **Behaviour change, declared in the changeset.** A month name in another language no longer reads as a date. V8 accepted some by their first three letters (`7 octobre 2026`, `7 Januar 2026`, `Mars 7, 2026`) and never accepted others (`7 juin 2026`, `7 März 2026`). `2026年10月7日` is `NaN` to `Date.parse` and stays text. Reading localized date forms would be a new capability, not this card.
- **H3 (locale order).** `importParsers.ts` has no locale rule. V8 reads `07/10/2026` month-first (July 10), and that is unchanged.
- **Correction to the dispatch's control list.** `2026-10-07T12:00:00Z` infers as `datetime`, not `date`, both on `main` and after (`hasTimeComponent`). The pin says `datetime`.
- **Same family, not filed: the wizard's client value check.** `validateValue` in `ImportWizard.tsx` accepts any value `Date.parse` reads for a `date` / `datetime` field, so `Phase 2` mapped onto a date field is not marked red in the preview. Reach not measured. Carrier: objectui#11814 (that file's next card, the preview check). `isDateLike` stays module-private per the fence.
- **Observation, not filed.** `ObjectGrid.tsx`'s own name-based `inferColumnType` runs a `Date.parse` sample check whose two branches both return `date`, so the check decides nothing. Carrier: none.
- **`main` moved after the merge:** `31add5f` adds three commits, all in `packages/app-shell` and `.changeset/`, disjoint from this diff. They were not merged in.
